feature_contract.goal: Restore continuously adjustable, readable VR ESC pause shell and option arrows from 0.55 to 1.50 while maintaining optical centering and eye-consistent aspect correction.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only OutRun original ESC/pause shell ScreenOverlay2D and exact native ScreenHud clip-arrow producers; do not modify gameplay HUD, F11 external ImGui, GOAL/+TIME, rank, world, FFB, SkyGlow, DX11 or DXVK.
subcomponents: Pause state-scoped shell and exact-arrow scale control across the complete user setting
Two-eye optical containment, FOV-aware vertical placement and reversible desktop fallback
Positive, negative, boundary and mutation regression verification
trace_stages: Native GameState::STATE_SMPAUSEMENU original ESC producer state and ExactScreenHudClipSprite option-arrow semantic
R30IsPauseMenuElement and R30HudScopeScale share one size for native shell/arrow XYZRHW and vertex-shader draw paths
R30HudContainScale and VerticalAffine map source aspect plus asymmetric binocular FOV into each XR viewport

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: PauseMenuScale 0.55, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25 and 1.5 produce monotonic readable per-eye sizing, with no lower dead zone or abrupt upper optical plateau.
Native aspect and vertical head-forward centering persist with exact arrows, while nonresponsive/desktop and invalid-source fallback isolate gameplay HUD, F11 and world effects.
Exact validation-bearing SHA passes DX9Ex Active policy, Win32 game, full-chain, x64 host and package, plus Domain Isolation and material Full Source Impact.

diagnosis.root_cause: Original responsive ESC size calculation max(requested,1.25f) made every setting from 0.55 through 1.25 visually indistinguishable, while hard optical 2.25 ceiling flattened upper-range slider responses.

World projection and SkyGlow do not pass the exact pause scope and must not be globally rescaled.
